sources.summary: Furniture brand Karimoku has opened Oyado Mas, an exhibition of furniture and accessories by its Mas label, showcased in an environment designed to resemble an inn complete with a reception and guest room. Karimoku's Mas brand, which makes products using Japanese woods, provided the furniture for the exhibition, located in the Karimoku Commons Tokyo showroom The post Karimoku turns Tokyo showroom into "imaginary Japanese inn" appeared first on Dezeen .
